脱水大蒜__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"脱水大蒜","riskLevel":"low","summary":"脱水大蒜是将新鲜大蒜干燥后的天然调味食材，一般被认为安全健康。多数人日常食用不会造成健康问题。","details":"脱水大蒜保留了大部分大蒜中的硫化物等活性成分，具有增香和一定保健作用，不属于人工添加剂或防腐剂。少数对大蒜敏感或有胃肠道问题的人，大量食用可能引起胃部不适或口气加重。整体来看，它钠含量低、不含反式脂肪，也不属于常见过敏原。","category":"天然香辛料"}

食用盐__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"食用盐","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"食用盐是最常见的调味品之一，适量摄入对维持体液平衡和神经肌肉功能很重要。过量摄入则会增加高血压和心血管疾病的风险。","details":"长期高盐饮食与高血压、中风、心脏病、肾脏负担加重及水肿等健康问题密切相关，尤其是对本身有心肾疾病或高血压倾向的人群更需限制。世界卫生组织建议成人每日钠摄入量不超过约2克（相当于约5克食盐），许多加工食品中已经含有较高盐分，因此应注意总摄入量。对于一般健康人适量食用问题不大，但建议养成清淡饮食习惯。","category":"调味品/钠含量较高成分"}

焦糖色素__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"焦糖色素","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"焦糖色素是一种常见的食品着色剂，用于赋予饮料、酱汁和烘焙食品深褐色或棕色外观。一般摄入量下对大多数健康人相对安全。","details":"部分类型的焦糖色素在高温和特定工艺下可能产生4-甲基咪唑（4-MEI）等副产物，动物实验中高剂量与致癌风险相关，因此部分地区对其含量有严格限量。对焦糖色素或添加剂较敏感的人可能出现轻微过敏或不适，建议儿童及长期大量饮用深色汽水、酱油类产品的人适当控制摄入量。总体来说，适量食用风险较低，但应避免过度依赖含大量焦糖色素的加工食品和饮料。","category":"人工色素 / 食品添加剂"}

番茄酱（浓缩番茄膏）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"番茄酱（浓缩番茄膏）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"番茄酱是由番茄经过去皮、去籽并浓缩制成的天然原料，一般被认为相对安全。主要成分是番茄中的天然糖分、有机酸和番茄红素等营养物质。","details":"通常情况下，纯番茄酱不含人工色素、防腐剂或人工甜味剂，属于加工较简单的食材。如果在配料表中只写“番茄酱/番茄膏”而未列出其他添加剂，说明其添加成分较少，健康风险较低。需要注意的是，若产品整体含盐量较高，多以番茄酱为基础的酱料可能伴随较高钠含量，需留意营养成分表。","category":"天然植物原料"}

cultivos de queso (cultivos lácticos)__f.analysis: {"name":"Cultivos de Queso (cultivos Lácticos)","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Los cultivos de queso son bacterias beneficiosas utilizadas para fermentar la leche y desarrollar el sabor y la textura del queso.","details":"Estos cultivos suelen pertenecer a géneros como Lactobacillus y Streptococcus, considerados seguros y habitualmente presentes en alimentos fermentados. Contribuyen a la conservación natural del producto y, en general, no representan un riesgo significativo salvo en individuos con inmunosupresión grave o con alergias muy específicas a componentes microbianos, lo cual es poco frecuente.","category":"Fermentos lácticos / Microorganismos beneficiosos"}

egg whites__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Egg Whites","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Egg whites are a high-protein ingredient but are a common allergen for some people.","details":"They provide mostly protein with very little fat or cholesterol, making them a generally healthy ingredient for most individuals. However, people with egg allergies must strictly avoid egg whites, and sensitive individuals may experience reactions ranging from mild to severe.","category":"Allergen, protein source"}

dextrose__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Dextrose","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Dextrose is a simple sugar that can contribute to increased blood sugar and overall sugar intake.","details":"It is chemically identical or very similar to glucose and is rapidly absorbed, which can cause quick spikes in blood sugar, especially concerning for people with diabetes or insulin resistance. Frequent or high intake of added sugars like dextrose is associated with weight gain, dental cavities, and increased risk of metabolic diseases when consumed in excess.","category":"Added sugar, carbohydrate"}

hydrogenated tallow__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Hydrogenated Tallow","riskLevel":"high","summary":"Hydrogenated tallow is a processed animal fat that may contain trans fats and high levels of saturated fat.","details":"Hydrogenation can create trans fatty acids, which are strongly associated with increased LDL (bad) cholesterol, decreased HDL (good) cholesterol, and higher risk of heart disease. Even when trans fat content is limited, the high saturated fat load from hydrogenated tallow can negatively impact cardiovascular health when eaten regularly or in large amounts.","category":"Hydrogenated fat, animal fat"}

high fructose corn syrup__food__en.analysis: {"name":"High Fructose Corn Syrup","riskLevel":"high","summary":"High fructose corn syrup (HFCS) is a refined liquid sweetener made from corn starch with a high proportion of fructose. Frequent consumption is strongly linked to weight gain, fatty liver, and metabolic disturbances when part of a high-sugar diet.","details":"HFCS is rapidly absorbed and can promote insulin resistance, increased visceral fat, elevated triglycerides, and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease when consumed in excess. It also contributes to high overall sugar intake, which is associated with higher risks of type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and dental caries. For most people, limiting foods and drinks containing HFCS is advisable, especially when trying to manage weight, blood sugar, or heart health.","category":"Added sugar / sweetener"}

corn syrup__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Corn Syrup","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Corn syrup is a refined sweetener made from corn starch that consists mainly of glucose. It contributes significant added sugar and calories but generally has less fructose than high fructose corn syrup.","details":"Like other added sugars, corn syrup can promote weight gain, elevated blood triglycerides, and increased risk of insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes when consumed in large amounts. It also adds to overall sugar load, contributing to dental cavities and poorer diet quality when it displaces more nutrient-dense foods. Occasional intake in small amounts is unlikely to pose major health issues, but regular high intake should be limited.","category":"Added sugar / sweetener"}

niacin__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Niacin","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Niacin is a B vitamin (vitamin B3) commonly added to foods as a nutrient fortifier. It is generally safe at the amounts used in fortified foods.","details":"Niacin helps the body convert food into energy and supports normal nervous system and skin function. Very high supplemental doses can cause flushing or liver stress, but the levels in regular food products are well within established safety limits for most people.","category":"Vitamin / Nutrient fortifier"}

reduced iron or ferrous sulfate__food__e.analysis: {"name":"Reduced Iron or Ferrous Sulfate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Reduced iron and ferrous sulfate are forms of iron used to fortify foods and help prevent iron deficiency. They are considered safe for most people at food-fortification levels.","details":"Iron is an essential mineral needed for oxygen transport in the blood and normal energy metabolism. Excessive iron intake from multiple supplements or fortified foods can cause gastrointestinal discomfort and, in rare cases, iron overload, especially in people with conditions like hemochromatosis, but typical amounts in foods are not a concern for the general population.","category":"Mineral / Nutrient fortifier"}

thiamine mononitrate__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Thiamine Mononitrate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Thiamine mononitrate is a stable form of vitamin B1 used to enrich or fortify foods. It is generally recognized as safe at the levels added to food products.","details":"Thiamine supports carbohydrate metabolism and normal function of the nervous system and heart. Toxicity from thiamine is very rare because excess amounts are usually excreted, and the quantities used in food fortification are well below levels associated with any adverse effects.","category":"Vitamin / Nutrient fortifier"}

baking soda__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Baking Soda","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Baking soda (sodium bicarbonate) is a common leavening agent used in baked goods and is generally safe for most people in typical food amounts.","details":"In normal culinary quantities, baking soda is considered low risk, though it contributes some sodium, which may be a concern for individuals on sodium-restricted diets if consumed in large amounts. Very high intakes can cause digestive upset or electrolyte imbalance, but such intakes are uncommon from regular foods. It does not contain major allergens and is not an artificial color, flavor, or sweetener.","category":"Leavening agent"}

whey__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Whey","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Whey is a dairy-derived protein ingredient and a common allergen source for people with milk allergy or lactose intolerance.","details":"Whey comes from milk and therefore contains milk proteins and may contain varying amounts of lactose, posing a risk for those with cow’s milk allergy or lactose intolerance. For people without dairy issues it is generally safe and provides high-quality protein, but its presence must be clearly noted due to allergen concerns. It is not an artificial additive, color, or sweetener, but is categorized as a dairy allergen.","category":"Dairy allergen / Protein"}

locust bean gum__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Locust Bean Gum","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Locust bean gum is a plant-derived thickener and stabilizer commonly used in foods. It is generally considered safe for most people when consumed in typical food amounts.","details":"Locust bean gum is obtained from the seeds of the carob tree and is used to improve texture and prevent separation in products like ice cream, sauces, and dairy alternatives. Some individuals with sensitive digestion may experience gas or bloating with large amounts of gums, but adverse reactions are uncommon at normal dietary levels. It is not a common allergen and does not contain gluten, dairy, or soy.","category":"Food additive – thickener/stabilizer"}

dipotassium phosphate__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Dipotassium Phosphate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Dipotassium phosphate is a mineral-based additive used as an emulsifier, stabilizer, and acidity regulator. It is generally recognized as safe in the small quantities used in foods.","details":"This ingredient provides potassium and phosphate and is often added to creamers, processed cheeses, and beverages to improve texture and control acidity. In healthy individuals, normal food levels are unlikely to pose a risk, but people with kidney disease or those on restricted phosphate or potassium diets may need to limit phosphate and potassium additives overall. It is not an allergen and does not contribute artificial colors, flavors, or sweeteners.","category":"Food additive – emulsifier/buffering agent"}

chocolate liquor__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Chocolate Liquor","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Chocolate liquor is the ground, roasted cocoa bean paste that forms the base of chocolate. It is generally safe for most people but contains natural stimulants like caffeine and theobromine.","details":"Chocolate liquor is not alcoholic; it is a mixture of cocoa solids and cocoa butter derived from cocoa beans. Its main health considerations are its caffeine and theobromine content, which may be an issue for sensitive individuals or in large amounts. It can also contain trace amounts of allergens if processed in shared facilities, but it is not a major allergen by itself.","category":"Cocoa and chocolate ingredient"}

defatted soy flour (contains egg)__food_.analysis: {"name":"Defatted Soy Flour (contains Egg)","riskLevel":"high","summary":"Defatted soy flour is a high-protein soy product from which most oil has been removed, and this ingredient statement also indicates the presence of egg. It poses a high risk for individuals with soy or egg allergies.","details":"As a concentrated soy ingredient, defatted soy flour is a common source of plant protein and may contain anti-nutritional compounds typical of soy, though generally safe for most people. However, both soy and egg are major allergens, and exposure can trigger serious allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, including anaphylaxis. People with soy or egg allergies must avoid this ingredient, and those with multiple food sensitivities should review it carefully.","category":"Allergenic plant and animal protein"}

cocoa processed with alkali__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Cocoa Processed With Alkali","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Cocoa processed with alkali (Dutch-processed cocoa) is cocoa powder treated to reduce acidity and create a milder flavor and darker color. It is generally considered safe for most people when consumed in normal food amounts.","details":"The alkalization process (Dutching) can slightly reduce some natural antioxidants found in cocoa but does not introduce major safety concerns for the general population. People sensitive to caffeine or theobromine should still moderate cocoa intake, and those following very strict clean-label diets may prefer minimally processed cocoa. Overall, its health impact mainly depends on the overall product (sugar, fats, etc.) rather than this processing step itself.","category":"Processed cocoa ingredient"}

food starch modified__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Food Starch Modified","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Modified food starch is a starch (often from corn, potato, tapioca, or wheat) that has been physically or chemically altered to improve texture, stability, or shelf life. It is widely used as a thickener and stabilizer in many processed foods and is generally recognized as safe.","details":"Health concerns are usually low, but individuals with specific allergies or intolerances (such as wheat or gluten) should check the source of the starch if not specified. It may indicate a higher level of processing in the product, but it is not strongly linked to serious health risks at typical dietary levels. Regulatory authorities commonly allow its use in a wide range of foods.","category":"Thickener and stabilizer"}

sodium stearoyl lactylate__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Sodium stearoyl lactylate is an emulsifier commonly used in baked goods and processed foods to improve texture and shelf life. It is generally recognized as safe for most people when consumed within normal dietary amounts.","details":"This additive helps mix fats and water, improving dough strength, volume, and softness in products like bread and pastries. It is derived from fatty acids and lactic acid, and does not contain lactose or milk protein, so it is usually safe for people with lactose intolerance or milk allergy. Some sensitive individuals may prefer to limit intake of processed foods containing multiple emulsifiers, but there is no strong evidence of harm at typical consumption levels.","category":"Food additive / emulsifier"}

cottonseed oil__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Cottonseed Oil","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Cottonseed oil is a refined vegetable oil commonly used for frying and in processed foods. Its health impact depends on refining quality and how much is consumed, but it is often high in omega-6 fats and may contain trace pesticide residues if not well refined.","details":"Refined cottonseed oil is generally considered safe, but it tends to be high in polyunsaturated omega-6 fatty acids, which can contribute to inflammation if consumed excessively compared with omega-3 fats. Because cotton is often heavily treated with pesticides and is not grown as a food crop, there are concerns about potential contaminants, though proper refining greatly reduces these. As with most refined oils, regular high intake—especially in deep-fried and ultra-processed foods—is best limited for cardiovascular health.","category":"Refined vegetable oil"}

bleached wheat flour__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Bleached Wheat Flour","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Bleached wheat flour is a refined flour treated with bleaching agents to improve color and baking qualities. It contains gluten and is unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.","details":"Because it is refined, bleached wheat flour has much of the fiber, vitamins, and minerals removed compared with whole wheat flour, making it less nutritious. The bleaching process can involve chemical agents (such as benzoyl peroxide or chlorine-based compounds), which are generally recognized as safe but add no nutritional benefit. It poses a clear risk for individuals with gluten-related disorders and may contribute to blood sugar spikes due to its high glycemic index.","category":"Refined grain, gluten-containing"}

malted barley flour__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Malted Barley Flour","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Malted barley flour is made from sprouted and dried barley and is often used in small amounts to improve flavor, color, and texture in baked goods. It contains gluten and is not safe for people with celiac disease or gluten intolerance.","details":"Nutritionally, malted barley flour can add some enzymes and flavor but is usually present in minor quantities in processed foods. Its primary health concern is its gluten content, which can trigger adverse reactions in individuals with celiac disease or non-celiac gluten sensitivity. For the general population it is typically low risk, but those requiring gluten-free diets must avoid it.","category":"Cereal grain, gluten-containing"}

corn syrup solids__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Corn Syrup Solids","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Corn syrup solids are a dehydrated form of corn syrup used as a sweetener and bulking agent. They contribute added sugars and have a high glycemic impact.","details":"Corn syrup solids are made by concentrating and drying corn syrup, providing easily digestible glucose that can spike blood sugar levels. Regular high intake of added sugars is associated with weight gain, insulin resistance, and increased risk of metabolic diseases. They are generally recognized as safe, but people managing blood sugar or overall sugar intake should limit them.","category":"Sweetener / Refined carbohydrate"}

calcium sulfate__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Calcium Sulfate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Calcium sulfate is a mineral-based additive used as a firming agent, dough conditioner, or source of calcium. It is generally considered safe in the low amounts used in foods.","details":"This compound occurs naturally and is used in foods like tofu, baked goods, and some beverages to improve texture or provide calcium fortification. Typical dietary exposures are low and not associated with significant health concerns for most people. Extremely high intake could cause digestive discomfort, but this is unlikely from normal food use.","category":"Mineral additive / Firming agent"}

egg__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Egg","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Egg is a common whole-food ingredient that provides protein, fats, and micronutrients. It is also a major allergen and can cause serious reactions in sensitive individuals.","details":"Eggs are nutrient-dense and generally safe for most people, though those with certain conditions may monitor cholesterol and saturated fat intake. However, egg is one of the most frequent causes of food allergy, especially in children, and reactions can range from mild to life-threatening anaphylaxis. People with egg allergy or those following vegan diets should avoid products containing egg.","category":"Allergen / Animal-derived ingredient"}

titanium dioxide (color)__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Titanium Dioxide (color)","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Titanium dioxide is an inorganic white pigment used to whiten or brighten foods. Its safety has become controversial due to concerns about potential effects of nanoparticles and possible genotoxicity at high or chronic exposures.","details":"Regulatory agencies differ: the EU has banned titanium dioxide (E171) as a food additive based on unresolved uncertainties about genotoxicity, while some other authorities still permit it within specified limits. Typical dietary exposure from occasional consumption is likely low for most people, but long-term frequent intake may pose theoretical risks, especially where nanoparticle-sized particles are present. Consumers seeking to minimize precautionary risk often choose products without this colorant, particularly for children or those aiming to reduce unnecessary additives.","category":"Color additive"}

monocalcium phosphate__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Monocalcium Phosphate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Monocalcium phosphate is a leavening agent commonly used in baking powders to help doughs and batters rise. It is generally recognized as safe when consumed within normal dietary amounts.","details":"In food products, monocalcium phosphate reacts with baking soda to release carbon dioxide, improving texture and volume in baked goods. For most healthy individuals, the phosphate contribution from typical use is modest, but people with advanced kidney disease or those on strict phosphate-restricted diets may need to monitor overall phosphate intake. In the general population, its use at regulated levels is not considered a major health concern.","category":"Leavening agent / food additive"}

sorbic acid and potassium sorbate__food_.analysis: {"name":"Sorbic Acid And Potassium Sorbate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Sorbic acid and potassium sorbate are food preservatives used to inhibit the growth of molds, yeasts, and some bacteria. They are generally recognized as safe for most people at the levels used in foods.","details":"These preservatives help extend shelf life and maintain freshness by preventing microbial spoilage. Most people tolerate them well, though a small number of individuals may experience mild sensitivities or irritation, especially with very high intake or in cosmetics. Overall, their toxicological profile is considered favorable compared with many older preservatives.","category":"Preservative"}

agave syrup__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Agave Syrup","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Agave syrup is a sweetener derived from the agave plant, often marketed as a natural alternative to sugar. It is typically high in fructose, which can stress the liver when consumed in excess.","details":"Despite its natural image and lower glycemic index, agave syrup can contribute to increased calorie and sugar intake and may negatively impact blood lipids and insulin sensitivity if used heavily. For people with diabetes, fatty liver, or metabolic syndrome, frequent or large consumption is not advisable. In moderate amounts as part of an overall low-added-sugar diet, it is generally tolerated by most healthy individuals.","category":"Sweetener"}

inulin__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Inulin","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Inulin is a type of soluble fiber that acts as a prebiotic, feeding beneficial gut bacteria. It is generally safe and may support digestive and metabolic health.","details":"Because inulin is fermentable, some people can experience gas, bloating, or abdominal discomfort, especially when intake increases rapidly or at higher doses. Most healthy individuals tolerate small to moderate amounts well and may benefit from improved bowel regularity and gut microbiota diversity. People with irritable bowel syndrome or sensitive digestion may need to limit or introduce it gradually.","category":"Dietary fiber / Prebiotic"}

riboflavin__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Riboflavin","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Riboflavin is vitamin B2, an essential nutrient commonly added to foods for fortification. It is generally safe and well tolerated at typical dietary levels.","details":"Riboflavin plays a key role in energy production and cellular function, and deficiency can lead to fatigue and skin or eye issues. It is water‑soluble, and excess amounts are usually excreted in urine, giving it a bright yellow color. Adverse effects are rare and typically associated only with extremely high supplemental doses.","category":"Vitamin / Nutrient"}

folic acid__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Folic Acid","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Folic acid is a synthetic form of vitamin B9 used to fortify foods and prevent deficiencies. It is especially important for pregnant people to support healthy fetal development.","details":"Adequate folic acid intake helps prevent certain birth defects and supports red blood cell formation and DNA synthesis. It is generally safe at typical fortification and supplement doses, though very high long‑term intakes may mask vitamin B12 deficiency in susceptible individuals. For most consumers, folic acid in fortified foods presents minimal risk and clear benefits.","category":"Vitamin / Nutrient"}

water__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Water","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Water is a basic, essential component of most foods and beverages. It is necessary for hydration and normal body function.","details":"In food products, water acts as a solvent, affects texture, and helps dissolve other ingredients. The main safety consideration is source and purity, but in regulated food production it is typically treated and monitored. For the average consumer, water as an ingredient in food poses minimal direct health risk.","category":"Base ingredient / Solvent"}

xanthan gum__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Xanthan Gum","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Xanthan gum is a common thickening and stabilizing agent used in many foods. It is generally recognized as safe for most people when consumed in normal food amounts.","details":"Xanthan gum is a polysaccharide produced by fermentation of sugars, often used to improve texture and shelf life in sauces, baked goods, and gluten-free products. In some individuals, especially in large amounts, it may cause mild digestive discomfort such as gas or bloating due to its fiber-like properties. People with severe corn, soy, or wheat allergies may need to verify the source of the fermentation substrate, though highly refined xanthan gum usually contains negligible allergenic protein.","category":"Thickener and stabilizer"}

agar__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Agar","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Agar is a gelling agent derived from seaweed and is widely used as a vegetarian alternative to gelatin. It is considered safe for most people and contributes dietary fiber.","details":"Agar is extracted from red algae and is used to create gels in desserts, confectionery, and some processed foods, as well as in microbiological media. It is largely indigestible and acts as soluble fiber, which can support bowel regularity but may cause mild digestive discomfort in sensitive individuals if consumed in large amounts. There are no common allergen concerns with agar, and it does not contain animal products.","category":"Gelling agent and stabilizer"}

cellulose gum__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Cellulose Gum","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Cellulose gum, also known as carboxymethyl cellulose, is a thickener and stabilizer derived from plant cellulose. It is generally recognized as safe and commonly used to improve texture and shelf life in foods.","details":"Cellulose gum is a modified form of cellulose that provides viscosity and helps prevent separation in products like sauces, ice creams, and baked goods. It is not significantly digested or absorbed, functioning similarly to dietary fiber, and may cause mild gas or bloating in some people at high intakes. It is not a common allergen and does not contribute sugars, fats, or sodium to the product.","category":"Thickener and stabilizer"}

cocoa__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Cocoa","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Cocoa is a natural ingredient derived from cocoa beans and is generally safe for most people when consumed in typical food amounts. Its main concerns relate to added sugars and fats in cocoa-based products rather than cocoa itself.","details":"Cocoa provides flavonoids and antioxidants, which may offer cardiovascular and cognitive benefits when consumed in moderation. Potential issues include caffeine and theobromine content, which can cause sensitivity in some individuals, and possible trace contaminants like heavy metals depending on sourcing and processing. People with caffeine sensitivity should moderate intake, but cocoa itself is not a major allergen.","category":"Natural flavoring and cocoa product"}

tallow__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Tallow","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Tallow is a rendered animal fat, high in saturated fat, which can contribute to elevated LDL cholesterol when consumed in excess. It is generally safe but may not be suitable for people limiting animal fats for cardiovascular or ethical reasons.","details":"Because tallow is rich in saturated fat, frequent or high intake may increase cardiovascular risk, especially in individuals with existing heart disease, high cholesterol, or other metabolic conditions. It does not typically contain trans fats unless further processed, but it is calorie-dense and can promote weight gain if overconsumed. It may also be unsuitable for certain religious, cultural, or dietary preferences such as vegetarian or vegan diets.","category":"Animal fat"}

soybean oil__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Soybean Oil","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Soybean oil is a common vegetable oil that is generally recognized as safe, but highly processed forms and frequent consumption may contribute to an imbalanced omega-6 to omega-3 ratio. It is also a potential concern for individuals with soy allergy.","details":"Refined soybean oil is typically low in trans fats unless it is partially hydrogenated, but it is high in omega-6 polyunsaturated fats, which may promote inflammation when consumed excessively without adequate omega-3 intake. People with soy allergy are often advised to avoid soybean oil, especially if it is not highly refined, due to potential residual proteins. In processed foods, soybean oil can be a major source of added fats and calories, contributing to weight gain and metabolic issues if eaten in large amounts.","category":"Vegetable oil"}

sodium acid pyrophosphate__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate","riskLevel":"low","summary":"Sodium acid pyrophosphate is a leavening agent used to help baked goods rise and to control color and texture. It is generally recognized as safe when consumed within typical food amounts.","details":"This additive (often associated with E450) provides a source of acidity that reacts with baking soda to release carbon dioxide in doughs and batters. High intake of phosphate additives may be a concern for people with kidney disease or those who must restrict phosphorus, but levels in normal diets for healthy individuals are usually not problematic. It does not contribute major allergens and is not known to cause sensitivity in most people.","category":"Leavening agent / food additive"}

polysorbate 60__food__en.analysis: {"name":"Polysorbate 60","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"Polysorbate 60 is a synthetic emulsifier used to stabilize mixtures and improve texture in foods such as whipped toppings and baked goods. It is approved for use in foods, but its highly processed nature and potential to cause mild digestive or sensitivity reactions raise some concern for frequent or high intake.","details":"This additive is produced from sorbitol, ethylene oxide, and fatty acids, and functions to keep oil and water mixed, improving smoothness and shelf life. While toxicological studies generally support its safety at regulated levels, some studies in animals suggest that high doses of polysorbates may affect gut barrier function and microbiota, although typical dietary exposures are much lower. Individuals with very sensitive digestion or those aiming to minimize synthetic additives may choose to limit products containing it.","category":"Emulsifier / synthetic food additive"}

硝酸硫胺（维生素b1）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"硝酸硫胺（维生素B1）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"硝酸硫胺是维生素B1的一种稳定形式，常用于食品强化以补充营养。正常摄入量下对大多数人来说是安全的。","details":"硝酸硫胺广泛用于强化谷物、面粉和零食，帮助维持能量代谢和神经系统功能。一般剂量下不良反应极少，仅极少数人可能对高剂量补充剂出现轻微胃肠不适或过敏反应。作为水溶性维生素，多余部分通常会通过尿液排出体外。","category":"维生素与营养强化剂"}

可可__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"可可","riskLevel":"low","summary":"可可是从可可豆中提取的天然原料，常用于巧克力和可可饮品。一般人群适量食用是安全的。","details":"可可本身不属于食品添加剂，而是天然农作物原料，含有多酚类抗氧化物质，但也含有少量咖啡因和可可碱，可能对对咖啡因敏感的人引起心悸或睡眠受影响。极个别人可能对可可或巧克力成分过敏，出现皮疹或消化不适，过敏人群应避免或在专业人士指导下食用。总体来说，在均衡饮食中适量摄入可可是低风险的。","category":"天然农作物原料"}

龙舌兰糖浆__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"龙舌兰糖浆","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"龙舌兰糖浆是一种从龙舌兰植物中提取的甜味剂，常被用来替代砂糖。虽然其血糖指数较低，但果糖含量通常较高。","details":"龙舌兰糖浆的主要成分是果糖，过量摄入可能增加甘油三酯、脂肪肝和代谢综合征等风险，对有代谢问题或非酒精性脂肪肝的人需特别注意。适量少量用于日常饮食一般对大多数健康人影响较小，但仍应控制总糖摄入，避免将其视为“完全健康”的甜味替代品。","category":"天然甜味剂/糖类"}

鸡蛋__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"鸡蛋","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"鸡蛋是常见的高质量蛋白质来源，营养价值较高。对于大部分健康人群适量食用是安全的，但对鸡蛋过敏者风险较大。","details":"鸡蛋富含优质蛋白质、维生素和矿物质，一般来说适量摄入有利于均衡饮食和营养补充。然而，鸡蛋是常见的食物过敏原之一，可能引起皮疹、呼吸困难甚至严重过敏反应，需过敏人群严格避免。对于有心血管疾病或需控制胆固醇的人群，应注意整体饮食结构和总胆固醇摄入量。","category":"常见致敏原/动物性蛋白"}

还原铁或硫酸亚铁__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"还原铁或硫酸亚铁","riskLevel":"low","summary":"还原铁和硫酸亚铁是常见的食用补铁剂，用于强化面粉、谷物等食品中的铁含量。对一般人群来说，在法规允许剂量范围内摄入是安全的。","details":"还原铁和硫酸亚铁有助于预防或改善缺铁性贫血，广泛用于强化早餐麦片、面包和营养补充食品。少数人空腹或大量摄入硫酸亚铁可能出现胃部不适、恶心或便秘，建议与食物同食以减轻刺激。儿童误食大量补铁产品可能有中毒风险，应注意妥善存放，避免过量摄入。","category":"营养强化剂 / 矿物质补充剂"}

水__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"水","riskLevel":"low","summary":"水是最基础且最安全的食品成分之一，广泛用于饮料和各类食品中。一般情况下对人体没有健康风险。","details":"在食品中，水通常作为溶剂、稀释剂或基础载体使用，有助于溶解其他成分并改善口感和质地。只要水源经过安全处理并符合饮用水标准，其微生物和重金属等污染物含量都在安全范围内，对大多数人来说是安全的。极少数情况下，如果水源处理不当，可能带来微生物或化学污染风险，但这属于水质管理问题而非成分本身的固有风险。","category":"基础成分/溶剂"}

山梨酸及山梨酸钾（保鲜用）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"山梨酸及山梨酸钾（保鲜用）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"山梨酸及山梨酸钾是常用的食品防腐剂，用于抑制霉菌、酵母及部分细菌生长以延长保质期。一般在法规允许剂量内食用被认为安全。","details":"山梨酸及其盐类山梨酸钾广泛应用于烘焙食品、饮料、酱料等食品中，以维持新鲜度并减少腐败变质的风险。多数人对其耐受良好，但极少数敏感人群可能出现轻微胃肠不适或皮肤刺激。只要在国家或地区规定的最大使用量范围内使用，对普通消费者的健康风险较低。","category":"防腐剂 / 食品添加剂"}

聚山梨醇酯60（吐温60）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"聚山梨醇酯60（吐温60）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"聚山梨醇酯60是一种常用的食品乳化剂和稳定剂，用于帮助油水混合并改善口感和结构。一般在法规允许的用量范围内被认为对大多数人较为安全。","details":"聚山梨醇酯60常用于烘焙食品、奶油、冰淇淋和人造黄油中，以防止分层并保持质地稳定。少数敏感人群可能出现轻微胃肠不适或过敏样反应，但并不常见。长期大量摄入的安全性仍在研究中，因此建议控制加工食品总体摄入量，保持饮食多样与均衡。","category":"乳化剂 / 食品添加剂"}

菊粉（菊苣纤维）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"菊粉（菊苣纤维）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"菊粉是一种可溶性膳食纤维，常从菊苣根等植物中提取，用于改善肠道健康和增加饱腹感。一般人群适量食用是安全的。","details":"菊粉可作为益生元，为肠道有益菌提供养分，有助于调节排便和血糖、血脂水平。部分敏感人群（如肠易激综合征患者）或一次性摄入量过高时，可能出现腹胀、放屁增多或轻微腹泻。对菊苣或相关植物严重过敏者需谨慎，但在普通食品中使用量通常较低，被多数人良好耐受。","category":"膳食纤维/益生元"}

叶酸__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"叶酸","riskLevel":"low","summary":"叶酸是一种水溶性维生素B9，常被添加到食品中用于营养强化。一般人群在推荐摄入量范围内食用是安全的。","details":"叶酸对细胞分裂和DNA合成十分重要，孕妇充足摄入有助于预防胎儿神经管缺陷。长期大剂量补充（通常来自补充剂而非普通食物）可能掩盖维生素B12缺乏等问题，因此不建议自行过量摄入。作为食品强化剂时，其用量通常远低于安全上限，对大多数消费者来说风险较低。","category":"维生素与营养强化剂"}

硬脂酰乳酸钠__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"硬脂酰乳酸钠","riskLevel":"low","summary":"硬脂酰乳酸钠是一种常用的食品乳化剂和改良剂，广泛用于面包、糕点等烘焙食品中。一般人适量摄入被认为是安全的。","details":"它的作用是改善面团的稳定性和体积，使食物口感更柔软细腻，并延缓老化变硬。在法规允许的用量范围内，对大多数健康人群毒性很低，但极少数人可能对添加剂整体较敏感，出现轻微肠胃不适。对脂肪或钠摄入需要严格控制的人群，应留意总体饮食中此类添加剂和钠的累积摄入量。","category":"乳化剂 / 食品改良剂"}

纤维素胶__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"纤维素胶","riskLevel":"low","summary":"纤维素胶是一种从植物纤维素提取并改性的增稠剂和稳定剂，常用于饮料、酱汁、冰淇淋和烘焙食品中。一般人群适量摄入被认为是安全的。","details":"纤维素胶属于不可消化的膳食纤维，主要作用是增加食物黏度、改善口感和稳定结构，通常不会被人体吸收。少数人大量摄入时可能会出现轻微腹胀或排气增多等肠胃不适。目前研究未发现其与严重健康风险有明确关联，在法规允许范围内使用对大多数人群是安全的。","category":"增稠剂 / 稳定剂"}

焦磷酸二氢钠（酸式焦磷酸钠）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"焦磷酸二氢钠（酸式焦磷酸钠）","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"焦磷酸二氢钠是一种常用的食品添加剂，常见于发酵粉、加工肉制品和速食产品中，主要用作膨松剂和稳定剂。一般摄入量下对多数健康人相对安全，但会增加饮食中的钠摄入。","details":"作为膨松剂和酸度调节剂，焦磷酸二氢钠在烘焙食品中帮助产生二氧化碳，使食物蓬松，在加工肉制品中也可改善色泽和保水性。其本身毒性较低，但含有较高钠离子，长期大量摄入可能不利于高血压、心血管疾病或需要限制钠摄入的人群。部分对磷酸盐较为敏感或有肾功能问题的人，应适当控制含磷酸盐添加剂食品的摄入。","category":"食品添加剂 / 膨松剂与酸度调节剂"}

核黄素（维生素b2）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"核黄素（维生素B2）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"核黄素是一种水溶性维生素B族成分，常用作营养强化剂。正常食用量下对大多数人来说是安全的。","details":"核黄素有助于能量代谢及维持皮肤、眼睛和神经系统的正常功能，常被添加到面粉、早餐谷物等食品中进行营养强化。过量摄入通常会通过尿液排出，偶尔可见尿液颜色变黄属正常现象。极少数人可能对高剂量补充剂有轻微胃肠不适，但在普通食品中的含量一般不会造成健康风险。","category":"维生素 / 营养强化剂"}

烟酸（维生素b3）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"烟酸（维生素B3）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"烟酸是一种水溶性维生素B族营养素，常被添加到食品中用于营养强化。正常摄入量下对大多数人来说是安全且有益的。","details":"作为营养强化剂，烟酸有助于能量代谢和神经系统的正常功能，一般添加量在法规允许范围内，安全性较高。极高剂量（通常来自补充剂而非普通食品）可能导致潮红、皮肤发热、瘙痒或肝功能负担，因此不建议长期过量额外补充。对个别对烟酸特别敏感或患有严重肝病的人群，应留意总摄入量并遵医嘱。","category":"维生素与营养强化剂"}

乳清__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"乳清","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"乳清是牛奶在制奶酪或酪乳过程中分离出的乳蛋白和乳糖混合物，常用于提供优质蛋白。对大多数人来说是安全的，但对乳制品过敏或乳糖不耐受者可能存在风险。","details":"乳清富含优质蛋白和支链氨基酸，有助于肌肉合成和增加饱腹感，因此被广泛用于蛋白粉、烘焙食品和饮料中。对于乳蛋白过敏者，极小剂量也可能诱发过敏反应，如皮疹、呼吸困难等；乳糖不耐受者食用含乳糖的乳清产品可能出现腹胀、腹泻。对肾功能严重受损人群，大量高蛋白摄入需在医生指导下进行。","category":"乳制品成分/过敏原"}

氢化牛脂__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"氢化牛脂","riskLevel":"high","summary":"氢化牛脂是一种经过部分或完全氢化处理的动物脂肪，常含有反式脂肪酸。长期大量摄入与心血管疾病风险升高密切相关。","details":"氢化牛脂在食品中主要用于提供结构和延长保质期，但氢化过程会产生反式脂肪酸，可升高低密度脂蛋白胆固醇并降低高密度脂蛋白胆固醇，促进动脉粥样硬化。部分人群（如高血脂、心血管疾病患者、肥胖或代谢综合征人群）应尽量减少或避免摄入含氢化脂肪的产品。许多国家已对反式脂肪含量进行严格限制，因此含有此类成分的食品不宜经常或大量食用。","category":"脂肪与油脂类添加成分"}

琼脂__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"琼脂","riskLevel":"low","summary":"琼脂是一种从海藻中提取的天然胶质，常用作食品增稠剂和凝胶剂。一般认为对大多数人来说是安全的。","details":"琼脂主要成分是多糖，不易被人体消化吸收，常用于果冻、布丁、糖果及素食产品中作为凝固剂和增稠剂。少量食用通常不会带来健康问题，但一次性大量摄入可能会引起部分人轻微胀气或肠道不适。对海藻或相关成分极其敏感的人应留意自身反应，但此类情况较为少见。","category":"食品增稠剂 / 凝胶剂"}

二氧化钛（色素）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"二氧化钛（色素）","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"二氧化钛是一种常用的白色食用色素，用于增加或增强食品的白度和不透明度。一般摄入量较低时被多数监管机构认为是可接受的，但其长期安全性近年存在一定争议。","details":"部分动物和细胞实验显示，纳米级或长期高剂量摄入二氧化钛可能与炎症和潜在致癌风险相关，因此一些地区（如欧盟）已限制或禁止其在食品中的使用。对大多数健康成年人而言，偶尔少量摄入通常风险不大，但不建议大量频繁食用含有此色素的超加工食品。孕妇、儿童及对添加剂较敏感人群可适当减少含二氧化钛产品的摄入，尽量选择成分更简单、添加剂更少的食品。","category":"着色剂 / 食品添加剂"}

天然香料和人工香料__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"天然香料和人工香料","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"天然香料和人工香料是用于增强或改变食品气味和味道的复合添加剂。配方通常不透明，可能含有多种化学成分。","details":"天然香料来自植物或动物来源，但在工业加工中可能经过提纯和化学处理；人工香料则多为实验室合成，结构类似或模拟天然风味成分。总体来说，在法规允许剂量内对大多数人是安全的，但对敏感人群（如对某些化学香料、溶剂或载体不耐受者）可能引起头痛、皮疹或胃肠不适。由于具体成分未标明，难以评估潜在过敏原或个别物质的长期健康影响，建议儿童、孕妇及过敏体质人群适量摄入并留意身体反应。","category":"香精与增味剂"}

小苏打（碳酸氢钠）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"小苏打（碳酸氢钠）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"小苏打是一种常见的食品膨松剂和酸碱调节剂，一般少量食用是安全的。适量用于烘焙食品中，有助于面团膨松。","details":"正常饮食中摄入的小苏打量通常较低，对大多数健康人群来说风险较小。但如果长期或大量摄入，可能导致钠摄入过高，从而增加高血压、心血管负担或水肿等风险，对肾功能不佳或需要限钠饮食的人尤其需要注意。对一般消费者来说，控制整体饮食中的盐和含钠添加剂总量即可降低潜在健康影响。","category":"膨松剂 / 酸碱调节剂"}

磷酸一钙__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"磷酸一钙","riskLevel":"low","summary":"磷酸一钙是一种常见的食品添加剂，常用作膨松剂和钙、磷营养强化剂。一般人适量食用被认为是安全的。","details":"磷酸一钙常见于烘焙食品和速溶粉类产品中，帮助面团膨松并改善口感，同时补充一定的钙和磷。正常饮食摄入量通常远低于安全上限，但长期大量摄入含多种磷酸盐添加剂的加工食品，可能增加肾功能不全人群的负担。肾病患者或需限制磷摄入的人群应留意总磷摄入量，尽量少吃高添加剂的高度加工食品。","category":"膨松剂 / 矿物质强化剂"}

黄原胶__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"黄原胶","riskLevel":"low","summary":"黄原胶是一种常见的食品增稠剂和稳定剂，常用于饮料、酱料、烘焙制品等，以改善质地和口感。一般摄入量下对大多数人而言较为安全。","details":"黄原胶由糖类经微生物发酵制得，属于可溶性膳食纤维，通常不会被人体完全消化，仅少量会在肠道被发酵。少数人摄入较大量时可能出现轻微胀气或腹部不适，肠易激综合征或对增稠剂敏感人群应适量控制。总体来说，在法规允许用量内使用的黄原胶对健康风险较低。","category":"食品增稠剂/稳定剂"}

角豆胶__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"角豆胶","riskLevel":"low","summary":"角豆胶是一种从角豆树种子中提取的天然增稠剂和稳定剂，常用于冰淇淋、酸奶、酱料等食品中。大多数人摄入量在正常范围内通常是安全的。","details":"角豆胶（又称刺槐豆胶，E410）是水溶性膳食纤维，可改善食品的黏稠度和口感，并帮助防止分层和结冰晶。一般不会引起毒性问题，但个别人大量摄入时可能出现腹胀、排气增多或轻微肠胃不适。对豆科植物极度敏感或有特殊肠道疾病（如严重肠易激综合征）的人群，建议留意自身耐受情况并适量食用。","category":"增稠剂 / 稳定剂 / 膳食纤维"}

玉米糖浆固体__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"玉米糖浆固体","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"玉米糖浆固体是由玉米淀粉经过水解并干燥后形成的粉末状甜味剂，主要成分为葡萄糖等简单糖类。其含糖量高，几乎不含营养素。","details":"适量摄入对大多数人来说一般是安全的，但由于其为高精炼糖源，过量摄入可能增加肥胖、2 型糖尿病和代谢综合征的风险。与高果糖玉米糖浆类似，长期大量食用含有大量玉米糖浆固体的加工食品，还可能不利于控制血糖和心血管健康。对于需要控制血糖或体重的人群，应尽量减少此类添加糖的摄入。","category":"甜味剂 / 添加糖"}

改性淀粉__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"改性淀粉","riskLevel":"low","summary":"改性淀粉是经过物理或化学方式处理的淀粉，常用于增稠、稳定和改善食品口感。一般人群适量摄入通常被认为是安全的。","details":"改性淀粉多来源于玉米、马铃薯或木薯等淀粉，通过改变结构来增强耐热性、耐酸性和稳定性，常见于酱汁、速食汤、零食和冷冻食品中。对大多数人来说安全性较高，但对淀粉来源（如小麦）过敏或对麸质高度敏感的人需关注具体来源。长期大量摄入并不会被认为是有毒的，但它属于加工配料，整体饮食仍应以天然食材为主。","category":"增稠剂与稳定剂"}

硫酸钙__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"硫酸钙","riskLevel":"low","summary":"硫酸钙是一种常见的食品添加剂，用作凝固剂、稳定剂或营养强化剂（补充钙）。在法规允许的用量范围内，一般被认为对大多数人较为安全。","details":"硫酸钙常用于豆腐、面包、烘焙食品及部分饮料中，以改善结构或增加钙含量。正常膳食摄入量下通常不会带来明显健康风险，但过量摄入钙可能在肾功能不全者中增加肾结石风险。对钙摄入需特别注意的人群（如肾病患者）应留意整体饮食中各来源的钙总量。","category":"食品添加剂 / 凝固剂 / 矿物质强化剂"}

漂白小麦粉__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"漂白小麦粉","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"漂白小麦粉是经过精炼和化学或物理漂白处理的小麦粉，常用于面包、糕点等烘焙食品。其含有麸质，可能引发对小麦或麸质过敏/不耐受人群的症状。","details":"漂白小麦粉在精制过程中去除了大部分麸皮和胚芽，营养密度较全麦粉低，一般会强化添加铁和部分维生素以弥补流失。漂白过程可能使用过氧化苯甲酰等漂白剂，多数国家在允许范围内使用被认为安全，但部分人会担心长期高比例摄入精制谷物与血糖波动、体重管理等问题。对乳糜泻、麸质不耐受或小麦过敏者，应完全避免含有漂白小麦粉的食品。","category":"谷物及含麸质过敏原"}

牛脂（动物脂肪）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"牛脂（动物脂肪）","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"牛脂是从牛肉或牛油中提炼的动物脂肪，主要成分为饱和脂肪和少量反式脂肪。适量食用对一般人相对安全，但过量可能增加心血管疾病风险。","details":"牛脂在食品中常用于油炸或作为起酥油，能提供酥脆口感和浓郁风味，但其饱和脂肪含量较高，长期高摄入与血脂异常和心血管疾病相关。部分牛脂在高温反复油炸时可能产生少量反式脂肪和氧化产物，对心血管健康不利。对于需要控制胆固醇、心血管疾病风险或正在减脂的人群，应限制摄入频率和总量。","category":"动物脂肪 / 饱和脂肪来源"}

玉米糖浆__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"玉米糖浆","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"玉米糖浆是一种由玉米淀粉水解而成的液体糖，常用于饮料、糖果和烘焙制品中作为甜味剂和增稠剂。长期大量摄入含糖饮料和高糖食品与肥胖、2型糖尿病和龋齿风险增加有关。","details":"玉米糖浆主要成分是葡萄糖等可迅速被吸收的糖类，本身对多数人不是过敏原，但会明显增加饮食中的游离糖摄入量。经常大量食用含玉米糖浆的加工食品，可能导致能量摄入过多、血糖波动加大和胰岛负担增加。对于需要控制血糖、体重或代谢综合征风险的人群，应减少这类含糖配料较多的食品摄入，优先选择天然、低糖或无添加糖产品。","category":"甜味剂 / 糖浆"}

麦芽大麦粉__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"麦芽大麦粉","riskLevel":"low","summary":"麦芽大麦粉是由发芽大麦干燥并研磨而成的面粉，常用于烘焙以改善风味和发酵效果。一般人群食用较为安全，但对麸质敏感或患有乳糜泻的人需要避免。","details":"麦芽大麦粉含有一定量的糖类和酶，可以帮助面团上色并提升面包的香味与口感。它天然含有麸质，可能引发对麸质过敏或乳糜泻患者的肠道不适、腹胀或腹泻等症状。对大麦或谷物蛋白不过敏的人群通常可以安全摄入，建议麸质不耐受人群选择无麸质替代品。","category":"含麸质谷物成分"}

高果糖玉米糖浆__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"高果糖玉米糖浆","riskLevel":"high","summary":"高果糖玉米糖浆是一种从玉米淀粉提取并经酶处理得到的液体甜味剂，含有较高比例的果糖。长期大量摄入与肥胖、2型糖尿病和非酒精性脂肪肝等慢性疾病风险增加有关。","details":"高果糖玉米糖浆常用于碳酸饮料、果味饮料、糖果和烘焙食品中，成本低且甜度高，会显著增加饮食中的游离糖摄入量。研究显示，过量果糖在肝脏中代谢，可能促进脂肪合成，增加甘油三酯和内脏脂肪堆积，从而提高代谢综合征和心血管疾病风险。对需控制体重、血糖或脂肪肝的人群，建议尽量减少含高果糖玉米糖浆食品的摄入，整体饮食应以天然、少加工食物为主。","category":"甜味剂 / 添加糖"}

脱脂大豆粉（含蛋）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"脱脂大豆粉（含蛋）","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"脱脂大豆粉是以去除大部分油脂的大豆制成的蛋白质和碳水化合物来源，本身营养价值较高。由于该成分含有大豆和鸡蛋，属于常见强致敏原，对过敏人群存在一定风险。","details":"脱脂大豆粉提供丰富的大豆蛋白和膳食纤维，一般人群适量食用是安全的，但大豆异黄酮和植酸等成分可能在大量长期摄入时影响部分人群的激素代谢或矿物质吸收。标签中标明“含蛋”，说明产品在加工中加入了鸡蛋蛋白或存在鸡蛋交叉污染，对大豆或鸡蛋过敏、患有大豆相关激素敏感疾病（如部分甲状腺疾病或乳腺激素敏感问题）的人需要特别注意。儿童、孕妇及过敏体质者建议在医生或营养师指导下食用，其他人群则可视为常规蛋白质来源。","category":"蛋白质来源 / 过敏原（大豆、鸡蛋）"}

蛋清__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"蛋清","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"蛋清是鸡蛋中去除蛋黄后剩余的蛋白质部分，脂肪含量低、蛋白质含量高，一般人群适量食用是安全的。对于需要控制脂肪摄入或增加优质蛋白的人群较为有益。","details":"蛋清本身不含人工添加剂、反式脂肪或高糖、高钠成分，是较为天然且营养集中的蛋白来源。然而，蛋清是常见的八大食物过敏原之一，对鸡蛋过敏人群即使少量摄入也可能引发皮疹、呼吸困难、胃肠不适甚至严重过敏反应。对鸡蛋不过敏的人一般可放心食用，但有肾脏疾病或需限制蛋白质摄入者应咨询医生后再决定食用量。","category":"天然动物性蛋白质 / 过敏原"}

棉籽油__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"棉籽油","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"棉籽油是一种从棉籽中提取的植物油，常用于油炸和加工食品中。由于可能含有较高的ω-6脂肪酸和精炼过程中残留物，长期大量摄入对心血管健康可能不利。","details":"棉籽油在精炼前含有天然毒素游离棉酚，正规工艺会大幅去除，但质量不佳或监管不严时可能存在残留风险。它多用于深度油炸和工业化食品，这些食品往往含有较高热量和潜在氧化产物，可能增加炎症和心血管负担。对于有心血管疾病风险或需要控制炎症的人群，建议适量摄入并优先选择橄榄油等更健康的脂肪来源。","category":"植物油 / 脂肪"}

大豆油__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"大豆油","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"大豆油是一种常见的植物食用油，来源于大豆，含有一定比例的多不饱和脂肪酸。对大多数人来说适量食用较为安全，但大豆过敏者需避免。","details":"精炼大豆油在工业加工中通常会经历脱胶、脱酸、脱色和脱臭等步骤，部分产品可能含有较多ω-6多不饱和脂肪酸，长期大量摄入可能促进体内炎症反应，不利于心血管健康。大豆油并非反式脂肪本身，但若经过部分氢化处理（配料表一般会标注“氢化植物油”或“部分氢化植物油”），则会产生反式脂肪酸，需格外注意。对大豆蛋白严重过敏人群一般对高度精炼大豆油反应较少，但仍建议遵医嘱谨慎选择。","category":"植物油 / 过敏原相关"}

磷酸二钾__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"磷酸二钾","riskLevel":"low","summary":"磷酸二钾是一种常用的食品添加剂，用作缓冲剂、稳定剂和螯合剂，帮助调节酸碱度并改善产品口感与稳定性。一般摄入量下对大多数健康人来说较为安全。","details":"在食品中，磷酸二钾常用于乳制饮料、速溶咖啡、肉制品和烘焙食品中，以维持合适的pH值、提高溶解性并防止结块。正常饮食情况下摄入的磷酸盐对人体通常无明显危害，但过量摄入磷可能增加肾病患者、心血管疾病高风险人群和骨质疏松风险人群的负担。对需要控制钾或磷摄入（如慢性肾病患者）的人群，应适当限制含磷酸盐添加剂食品的摄入。","category":"食品添加剂 / 酸度调节剂与稳定剂"}

大豆和小麦成分（含生物工程/转基因成分）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"大豆和小麦成分（含生物工程/转基因成分）","riskLevel":"moderate","summary":"该配料说明产品中含有大豆和小麦成分，并标注含有生物工程（转基因）食品成分。对大豆或小麦（麸质）过敏者需特别注意，且部分消费者可能对转基因成分有所顾虑。","details":"大豆和小麦都是常见的致敏原，小麦中含有麸质，可能引发乳糜泻或麸质不耐受者的消化不适；大豆则可能导致皮疹、呼吸困难等过敏反应。标注“含生物工程食品成分”通常指原料中使用了转基因大豆或小麦，当前主流证据认为依法监管下的转基因原料在营养和安全性上与传统品种相近，但长期健康和生态影响仍有争议。一般人适量食用通常是安全的，但对过敏人群及对转基因较为敏感或有宗教/个人偏好的消费者，建议谨慎选择并控制摄入。","category":"含过敏原的谷物与豆类成分"}

可可液块（巧克力浆）__food__zh.analysis: {"name":"可可液块（巧克力浆）","riskLevel":"low","summary":"可可液块是由可可豆研磨制成的不加糖巧克力基底，是巧克力产品的主要原料之一。对大多数健康人来说适量食用较为安全。","details":"可可液块含有可可固形物和可可脂，富含多酚类抗氧化物质，但也含有一定量的咖啡因和可可碱，可能对对咖啡因敏感者或心血管疾病患者不利。它本身不含乳制品和麸质，但常与坚果、乳制品同线生产，可能存在交叉过敏风险，重度过敏人群需留意产品标签。总体而言，主要健康考量是热量和脂肪较高，需控制食用量。","category":"可可制品/巧克力原料"}
